description: agentnet.inventory/1 test vector. toml is an inventory.toml with every block; inventory is the JSON form PALS reads it as (Inventory::from_toml) and writes it back as: a field left out is unknown and stays out, never zero or empty; visibility is always written, "private" when the file leaves it out; hardware always carries "basis": "declared". The JSON form is what docs/extensions/inventory-v1/inventory.schema.json describes. The inventory is local: the views a peer reads leave out the adapter and whatever their scope does not show.
toml:
# An industrial OCR agent: every block of agentnet.inventory/1.

[[services]]
id = "ocr-metal-v1"
name = "Industrial OCR"
description = "Reads serial numbers stamped on metal parts"
capabilities = ["vision.ocr", "example:ocr-metal"]
tags = ["ocr", "metal"]
examples = ["Read the serial number in this photo"]
input_modes = ["image/png", "image/jpeg"]
output_modes = ["application/json"]
languages = ["en", "es"]
processing_region = "EU"
external_cloud_used = false
estimated_start_delay_ms = 500
estimated_duration_ms = 4000
limitations = ["Images up to 20 MiB"]
visibility = "public"
components = [
  { id = "example:ocr-model", role = "required" },
  { id = "example:workstation", role = "required" },
  { id = "example:vision-pack", role = "optional" },
]

[[services]]
id = "repo-review"
name = "Repository review"
description = "Reviews the demo repository and runs its tests"
capabilities = ["code.rust.review"]
visibility = { project = ["demo"] }
components = [
  { id = "example:repo-reader", role = "required" },
  { id = "project:repo-controller", role = "required" },
  { id = "example:assistant", role = "alternative", group = "reviewer" },
  { id = "example:rust-review", role = "alternative", group = "reviewer" },
]

[[skills]]
id = "example:rust-review"
description = "Procedure for reviewing Rust code for soundness and style"
provenance = "operator"
version = "1.2.0"
visibility = { project = ["demo"] }
package_id = "example/rust-review"
name = "Rust review"
offered_for = ["code review", "unsafe audit"]

[[plugins]]
id = "example:vision-pack"
description = "Vision tools for industrial inspection"
provenance = "operator"
version = "0.4.1"
visibility = "public"
runtime = "claude-code"
components = ["ocr", "deskew"]

[[mcp]]
id = "example:repo-reader"
description = "Reads the project repository"
provenance = "operator"
visibility = { project = ["demo"] }
server = "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem"
server_version = "2025.8.21"
tools = [
  { name = "read_file", description = "Reads a file", annotations = { readOnlyHint = true } },
  { name = "delete_file" },
]
resources = ["repo://demo"]
offered_tools = ["read_file"]

[mcp.adapter]
transport = "stdio"
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/srv/repo"]
env_passthrough = ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]

[runtime]
id = "example:claude-code"
description = "Claude Code in print mode"
provenance = "operator"
version = "2.0.0"
visibility = "public"
kind = "claude-code"
modes = ["print"]
restrictions = ["no network access outside the project"]

[[models]]
id = "example:ocr-model"
description = "OCR model for stamped metal"
provenance = "operator"
visibility = "public"
provider = "Example"
model_id = "example-ocr-metal"
revision = "2026-10-01"
role = "offered"
execution = { kind = "local" }
inference_runtime = "onnxruntime 1.20"
quantization = "int8"
precision = "int8"
modalities = ["image", "text"]

[[models]]
id = "example:assistant"
description = "The agent's main model"
provenance = "operator"
provider = "Anthropic"
mutable_alias = "claude-sonnet-latest"
role = "primary"
execution = { kind = "external", provider = "anthropic-api" }
modalities = ["text"]
context_tokens = 200000
output_tokens = 64000
dynamic_selection = "A smaller model may answer short questions"

[[information]]
id = "project:repo-controller"
description = "The controller repository"
provenance = "operator"
version = "a1b2c3d"
visibility = { task = ["demo"] }
expires_at = "2026-12-14T00:00:00Z"
evidence = { reference = "https://example.org/repo-controller/commit/a1b2c3d", hash = "blake3:5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b" }
domains = ["industrial control"]
languages = ["en"]
coverage = "main branch"
updated_at = "2026-11-14T00:00:00Z"
live = true
formats = ["text/x-rust"]
schema_ref = "https://example.org/repo-controller/README.md"
approximate_volume = "40k lines"
operations = ["answer_with_sources", "search", "process_in_place"]
limits = ["no export of whole files"]

[information.extensions]
"example:retention" = { days = 30 }

[hardware]
id = "example:workstation"
description = "Inspection workstation"
provenance = "operator"
visibility = "public"
cpu = { arch = "x86_64", model = "AMD Ryzen 9 7950X", cores = 16 }
ram_mib = 65536
accelerators = [{ kind = "gpu", model = "NVIDIA RTX 4090", count = 1, memory_mib_each = 24576 }]
storage = { kind = "nvme", capacity_gib = 2000 }
offered = { cpu_cores = 4, ram_mib = 8192, vram_mib_each = 8192, concurrency = 2, accelerators = ["gpu"] }

[network]
id = "example:uplink"
description = "Office uplink"
provenance = "operator"
visibility = "public"
transports = ["iroh-quic"]
region = "EU"
direct_connectivity_observed = true

services.name: Industrial OCR
services.description: Reads serial numbers stamped on metal parts
examples: Read the serial number in this photo

services.name: Repository review
services.description: Reviews the demo repository and runs its tests

skills.description: Procedure for reviewing Rust code for soundness and style
skills.name: Rust review

restrictions: no network access outside the project

models.dynamic_selection: A smaller model may answer short questions
